ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; white dominates the inner lobe surfaces while black is concentrated along margins and the central peduncle attachment area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Dense black focal region at the median notch convergence. Distinct 'brush-stroke' mottling and stippling patterns extending from the trailing edge towards the lobe centers, with higher density of dark clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 150 degrees; notch depth is minimal relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge. Right lobe exhibits significantly more jagged, high-amplitude peaks compared to the left lobe. A deep, distinct notch is visible approximately 10 pixels inward from the far right fluke tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature from the notch to the tips along the trailing edge; right tip exhibits a sharp upward/superior vertical hook, whereas the left tip is more horizontally aligned and blunt.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (stippling) distributed across the mid-ventral white zones of both lobes; highest concentration located in the lower-lateral quadrant of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel, dark linear tracks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the right lobe, extending from the upper-middle region toward the lower-right margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation/notch on the distal margin of the right fluke tip; distinct linear rake marks on the right lobe suggest previous physical interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry between fluke tips; right tip features a complex, hooked geometric profile with a secondary notch, while the left tip follows a standard rounded taper.
